info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Balance Retrieval API allows businesses to access and view the loyalty balances of their customers. This resource is essential for managing customer loyalty programs, enabling businesses to offer tailored rewards and incentives. Typical consumers of this API include loyalty program managers and customer service teams looking to enhance customer engagement. By leveraging this API, organizations can provide real-time balance updates and insights into customer loyalty trends, ultimately improving customer retention strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve their current loyalty balance, providing insights into their accumulated rewards and points.
